summary: Re-enables Close All with a confirmation modal; goal achieved, types/tests/lint green, live-validated (AC1/2/4) and test+code-proven (AC3/5). Already human-approved. Two non-blocking items: missing unit coverage for the partial/failed close-all branches, and a cosmetic cent-level rounding mismatch in the modal summary.

comments.body: The new partial-success branch (`successCount > 0 && failureCount > 0`) and the failed branch below it have no unit coverage in perps-view.test.tsx — the old cancel-all failure tests were removed, not replaced, so only the all-success and cancel paths are exercised. A mock returning `{ success: false, successCount: 1, failureCount: 1 }` would let you assert the CLOSE_ALL_PARTIAL toast and the `number_positions_closed: successCount` analytics. Separately, worth confirming with product that a partial close should be reported as `STATUS.FAILED` rather than a distinct partial status.

`youWillReceive` is computed from the unrounded `totalMargin` and `estimatedFees`, but the Margin and Fees rows display independently-rounded values (`roundedMargin`, `roundedFees`). So the summary can fail to reconcile by a cent — e.g. the live modal showed Margin $6.43 − Fees $0.03 but "You'll receive" $6.41. Cosmetic only; deriving receive from the same rounded values shown (or accepting the drift) would avoid the mismatch.
